notes: Stories already complete, non-duplicative, and aligned to required breakdown (schema, logic, API, integration, tests). No changes required.

stories.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty, pagination) and outputs (ranked provider list, scores, geo metadata) ensuring strict compatibility with tool_router and FindCareFacade contracts.

stories.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
stories.description: Implement provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search with deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy matching, including ranking strategy, geo filtering (state/city/county via FIPS), and result normalization.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into FindCareFacade and expose via tool_router and FastAPI endpoint(s) in main.py, ensuring strict alignment with tool schema and HTTP request/response contract.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Identification and Embedding Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate specialty_service (NUCC mapping, query expansion) and embedding_client (vector generation) into the provider search pipeline to support hybrid semantic + taxonomy search.

stories.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit tests for ranking, fallback, and geo filtering logic, plus integration tests validating full flow from tool_router → FindCareFacade → provider_search_service including vector + taxonomy behavior.
